response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack software engineer with 15+ years of experience, but this role requires a fundamentally different skill set he does not possess. He lacks the critical required native-level Japanese language proficiency, has minimal C programming experience despite it being a core requirement, and has no background in embedded firmware, network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption), Linux kernel development, or embedded networking devices. His expertise is primarily in web, mobile, and business applications, not embedded systems security.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (15+ years) with demonstrated ability to work across multiple programming languages and problem domains
Strong software engineering practices including CI/CD, testing, TDD, infrastructure management, and mentoring capabilities
Fluent English technical communication and proven ability to collaborate across teams
concerns: Missing native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicit requirement for the role
Very limited C programming experience (6 months at National Instruments) despite role requiring strong C proficiency for UNIX development
No background in embedded firmware, network security protocols, encryption technologies, Linux kernel analysis, or embedded networking devices

key_factors.factor: Missing embedded networking and security domain expertise
